text:
Raj (AE): Hey team — customer in EU wants a short POC run but insists on EU-only data flow and customer-managed keys. They sent a security checklist; a few Qs: do we have an on-prem option that supports BYOK? who are the subprocessors in EU regions? any implications for pricing / dedicated vs hosted?
Olivia (Solutions Eng): short answers: yes to VPC/private for BYOK, on-prem is possible but needs SRE handoff. subprocessors: GCP (europe-west), AWS (eu-west-1), Azure (northern europe) + some infra partners — i'll paste the public list. pricing: Dedicated monthly commit or Private license — higher than hosted.
Mia (Legal Ops): Can you attach the customer's checklist? need to map specific clauses to our subproc attestation + DPA. also need to confirm whether they require processor-level SOC2 + data locality in the contract.
Raj (AE): attached checklist (see thread) — they flagged: "no cross-border egress", "BYOK required for encryption at rest", "subprocessor list required", "incident notification SLA 24h".
Olivia (Solutions Eng): re: no cross-border egress — we can enforce routing policy on tenant for hosted in some cases but stronger guarantee comes from Dedicated or Private (VPC). For hosted: routing preference + geo-failover off can reduce cross-region traffic but not guaranteed contractually.
Sean (Infra Eng): to add: our Dedicated nodes can be pinned to eu-west-1 / eu-west-3 depending on cloud. For BYOK we support customer KMS via cross-account IAM + external key wrap for Private and Dedicated; hosted requires our managed KMS (we can offer BYOK in Private only).
Olivia (Solutions Eng): subprocessors quick list (public): 
- Google Cloud (europe-west1, europe-west4)
- AWS (eu-west-1, eu-west-2)
- Azure (westeurope, northeurope)
- Observability provider (EU data residency option)
- CDN partner (EU POPs only)
link: https://redwood.example.com/subprocessors (public page)
Mia (Legal Ops): we need the explicit subprocessor SLA/attestation PDF for EU data-only customers. @Olivia can you pull the latest attestation and confirm retention period options? also need to check KMS key access logs for audit clause.
Olivia (Solutions Eng): yes, i'll grab the attestation PDF and confirm retention options tomorrow. For KMS audit logs: Private deployment integrates with customer KMS/Audit — they keep logs; for Dedicated we can ship logs to customer S3/GCS.
Raj (AE): timeline check — customer wants POC in 3 weeks. doable?
Sean (Infra Eng): crunch: for Private on-prem, provisioning + security review ~6-8 weeks. Dedicated (reserved pool in eu) we can onboard faster if capacity free — estimate 2-3 weeks for dev POC with limited tokens. Hosted with routing preference only — immediate but doesn't meet BYOK.
Raj (AE): ok sounds like Dedicated is the likely fit. need cost delta for 3-week POC vs month commit.
Olivia (Solutions Eng): for short POC we can do a time-limited eval seat on Dedicated with a short-term invoice: rough numbers 
- Dedicated POC (small): $8k/week (includes reserved GPU min + support)
- Private on-prem (one-time setup): $60k + ops support (multi-week)
I'll confirm exact billing notes.
Mia (Legal Ops): also confirm indemnity+data residency carveouts in SOW. We'll need to run their checklist through our DPA exceptions flow.
Raj (AE): thanks. next steps: @Olivia pull attestation + exact subproc PDF, @Sean verify eu capacity and estimate on-boarding schedule, @Mia flag any non-negotiable legal items. I'll update customer with proposed Dedicated POC cost and ETA.
Olivia (Solutions Eng): on it. attaching a sample routing policy snippet they can reference:
```
route_preference: eu_only
failover_policy: none
kms_mode: customer_wrapped (private/dedicated only)
```
Raj (AE): perfect, i'll include that in the reply.
infra-bot: deployed routing-policy-template v1 to /internal/policies (artifact id: rtpl-2026-03) :white_check_mark:
Mia (Legal Ops): FYI if customer requires "no subprocessors outside EU" we need to be explicit — some vendor components (observability, monitoring) may process metadata in EU but have corporate HQ outside EU. we'll need the exact clause text to map.
Sean (Infra Eng): final note: network certs and cross-account KMS onboarding will need customer IAM role + a certificate rotation plan — include that in SOW.
Raj (AE): thanks everyone. I'll draft the customer email now and post for review before sending. :thumbsup:
